OpenAI Whisper speech-to-text, served as an OpenAI-compatible ASR endpoint.
Installs openai-whisper through pixi and runs a charly-owned FastAPI app
(app.py) as a supervised service on port 9000: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
(multipart `file`, optional `model`/`language`) returns a JSON body whose
top-level `text` is what Open Web UI reads, plus GET /health and GET /v1/models.
The checkpoint is loaded once per process and reused (never a CLI invocation per
request), prefetched onto a volume by the start script so the first request does
not pay for a download, and every knob below is env-configurable at deploy time.
env_provide publishes WHISPER_BASE_URL so a consumer (e.g. the openwebui candy)
discovers the endpoint through charly instead of a hand-typed variable.
Verifiable: the service answers /health, serves an OpenAI-shaped model list, and
transcribes a committed fixture through its own HTTP surface.

## Services

- `whisper-asr`

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | mkdir=${HOME}/.local/bin |
| `run` | copy the charly-owned ASR app |
| `run` | copy the fixture the transcription check decodes |
| `run` | write the start script — prefetch the checkpoint, then exec uvicorn |
| `check` | the ASR service answers its health endpoint |
| `check` | the served API advertises an OpenAI-shaped model list |
| `check` | the served API transcribes the committed fixture and returns its words |
| `check` | a model this server does not serve is refused, naming both |
